Emily - AE: Hey team, onboarding Acme POC next week. They want hosted API keys but with timebound access (2-week POC), auto-rotation every 48h, and ability to revoke immediately. Need checklist + any enterprise blockers.
Raj - SE: Quick Q — will they use short-lived ephemeral tokens or long-lived keys we rotate?
Emily - AE: They asked for keys we can rotate server-side; prefer not to integrate OIDC for the POC. Two-week window, might extend.
Sam - CloudOps: We can create scoped hosted keys with a TTL and automated rotation. For POCs we typically: create a project-scoped key, set scopes to generation+embeddings only, TTL 48h, and a refresh webhook to the AE. Can set auto-revoke at end date.
Marta - Security: Need to confirm audit log retention and whether keys are stored in customer-visible KMS — POC requires proof of revocation and an audit trail. Also request IP allowlist or CIDR restriction if they want.
Sam - CloudOps: Audit logs: yes, every key create/rotate/revoke is logged in our audit trail for 90 days (can extend for enterprise). We do not put hosted keys into customer KMS for self-serve POCs (that's a Private offering), but we can provide signed attestations and log exports. IP allowlist support: yes, per-key allowlist by CIDR.
Emily - AE: Great. Any friction for the AE to rotate keys manually if autopilot fails?
Sam - CloudOps: We provide a simple rotation endpoint and Console button. Example CLI to rotate: 
```bash
# rotate key via API
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/<KEY_ID>/rotate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN"
```
That returns the new key and marks the previous key as revoked after a TTL grace window.
Raj - SE: For the POC, can we enforce that new keys are delivered to Acme only via one-time download link and not persisted in logs?
Marta - Security: One-time download link is fine, but meta-event of creation must be logged. We can redact key values in exported logs. Also we should require 2FA on the AE user who requests keys.
Sam - CloudOps: We can enable 2FA requirement for the project and generate the one-time link. Rotation cron runs as a managed job; can be paused.
Emily - AE: SLA question from customer — they want guaranteed key rotate success or fallback to a read-only key. Possible?
Sam - CloudOps: We have a fallback policy: if rotation fails, traffic is routed to a read-only token with rate limits to avoid writing. For hosted POC keys we can enable this policy at creation.
Raj - SE: Any rate limit or quota impacts if we rotate every 48h?
Sam - CloudOps: No, rotation itself is metadata operation. But issuing fresh keys counts as key-creation events for our audit system; negligible. Token usage limits unchanged.
Marta - Security: Also propose short-lived scopes: generation but no admin endpoints, and disable key export via Console.
Emily - AE: Can we get a step-by-step checklist I can use with Acme and an example revocation command I can send them?
Sam - CloudOps: I'll add a minimal checklist here and a revoke curl: 
1) Create project in Console -> enable 2FA for AE account
2) Create hosted key: scopes ["generate","embeddings"], ttl=48h, allowlist=Acme CIDRs
3) Share one-time download link with Acme
4) Enable auto-rotation cron + fallback read-only token
5) Schedule POC end-date auto-revoke

Revoke example:
```bash
# revoke key immediately
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/keys/<KEY_ID>/revoke" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN"
```
infra-bot: Key creation audit event: key.create user=Sam project=acme-poc key_id=k_01GZxZ (logs: /audit/2024/2240001111.log) :white_check_mark:
Marta - Security: OK from security side pending confirmation on log export cadence. If Acme needs KMS-backed keys we switch them to Private offering and that's a sales uplift.
Emily - AE: Perfect — please drop the checklist and the ops snippets into the POC playbook and I'll send to Acme. Also note potential uplift to Private if they require KMS.
Sam - CloudOps: Done — I'll update the playbook and set the default rotation to 48h for this project. Will ping once keys created.
Raj - SE: Thanks — will stand by for integration questions during the POC.
Emily - AE: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
